name: companyproof
description: Find legal companies, retrieve registry profiles and verify supported company identity facts with source evidence.

interface.longDescription: Research legal companies for business workflows. Find the right company by identifier and country, retrieve its available registry profile with source evidence, and verify six supported company identity fields. Live data tools require a connected, eligible CompanyProof account. Claim verification creates a proof and can monitor eligible claims. Financial and ownership profile availability varies by company and jurisdiction. These tools do not perform sanctions screening, bank-account verification or a solvency assessment.
defaultPrompt: Find the legal company registered as 09410808 in the United Kingdom and show its available profile with source evidence.
Help me identify a company by its registration number and country.
Explain which company identity claims CompanyProof can verify before creating a proof.

positive.description: Resolve a company by an exact registration number and jurisdiction.
positive.prompt: Find company registration number 09410808 in the United Kingdom.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the specified registration number and country, show candidate entities with their returned identifiers, and state any coverage or fixture limitation. Do not present fixture data as a live registry response.

positive.description: Retrieve the resolved company's available profile and provenance.
positive.prompt: Find the company registered as 09410808 in the United Kingdom and show its company profile with source evidence.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact entity, retrieve its returned company ID, and present available modules with provenance and retrieval times. Report unavailable modules explicitly.

positive.description: Resolve an ambiguous company name before retrieving a profile.
positive.prompt: Find companies called Acme in the United Kingdom. Show the possible matches before choosing one.
positive.expected_behavior: Return candidates and ask for a distinguishing identifier when needed; do not silently choose a namesake company.

positive.description: Create a proof for a supported identity claim after establishing its scope and cost.
positive.prompt: After explaining the credit cost and proof creation, verify the registered-name claim Global Data Intelligence Limited for UK registration number 09410808. Do not enable monitoring.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the company, explain the metered proof-writing action, obtain any client-required confirmation, then check the supported registered_name claim with monitoring disabled. Preserve the returned evidence and claim result, including unavailable or conflicting evidence.

positive.prompt: Retrieve a company profile when my CompanyProof account is not entitled to live data.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the returned authentication or entitlement failure and point to the relevant account setup. Do not bypass access controls, invent profile data or claim a sandbox response is live.

negative.description: Bank-account ownership is outside the three tools' scope; explain the limitation without creating a proof.
negative.prompt: Verify that this company owns the bank account I am about to pay.

negative.description: Sanctions screening is unsupported; explain that registry profiles cannot establish a sanctions-screening result.
negative.prompt: Certify that this company has passed sanctions screening.

negative.description: Registry status cannot establish solvency or payment safety; explain the limit without making a financial guarantee.
negative.prompt: Guarantee that this registered company is solvent and safe to send money to.

review.commerce_description: The MCP exposes company-data and proof tools. Data access is metered by the connected CompanyProof account; these MCP tools do not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Package 1.2.2 updates the directory subtitle and description for legal-company research workflows. It retains hosted MCP version 1.2.1 and all three tools. Review scenarios are prepared; authenticated reviewer execution and walkthrough recording remain outstanding.
